The structure of Ba4Mg(FeO3)4 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 194), with a 24-atom unit cell and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Fe and Mg centers six O neighbors each in octahedral coordination, while Ba centers show a 12-coordinate, close-packed-like local arrangement. Corner-sharing between FeO6 and MgO6 octahedra is observed, alongside corner- and edge-sharing between FeO6 octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
